Messages.Author: Oortje
Messages.Body:
Do i get a pool if Maureen, Dark Priestess uses the the fragment?

Maureen, Dark Priestess
Independent: Maureen has 1 vote (titled). Once each turn, when Maureen
successfully performs an action requiring Baali or Daimoinon, you gain
1 pool. Infernal.

Kaymakli Fragment
Unique equipment.
This Sabbat vampire may allow you to draw 5 cards from your library as
an action (discard afterward). This infernal minion may move 3 blood
from the bank to a vampire in your uncontrolled region as a +1 stealth
action. Any minion may steal this equipment as a strike.

Thanks in advance.

Oortje

Messages.Author: Emiliano Imeroni
Messages.Body:


Why?!? Nowhere in the Fragment's card text it says it is an action
"requiring Baali or Daimoinon". So, no.

See you on Sunday at the launch event!

Emiliano

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
On Feb 1, 9:48 am, Oortje <internetoor...@hotmail.com> wrote:



"Infernal" does not equal "Baali" or "Daimonion".

Most (all?) Baali are infernal, but that does not mean all things
infernal are Baali. And a lot of daimonion cards require you to be
infernal, but that does not mean all things that require you to be
infernal are daimonion. That the Fragment requires you to be
"infernal" does not fill the requirements of Maureen's special ability
(which requires actions requiring "Baali" or "Daimonion").

-Peter
